findings.title: Signature compared with == (timing side channel); use hmac.compare_digest on bytes
verify() accepts any timestamp: `now` and `tolerance` are never used, so captured requests replay forever
Timestamp is not part of the signed message, so it can be changed without invalidating the signature
Every non-2xx response is retried, including permanent 4xx and 3xx failures
range(max_attempts + 1) makes one more attempt than max_attempts
Backoff exponent is off by one: first wait is 2x base_delay instead of base_delay
Exhausted retries return None silently (with a type: ignore) instead of raising DeliveryFailed
except Exception: pass swallows programming errors and hides failure causes
Mutable default `headers={}` is shared across calls: same X-Webhook-Id for every delivery and the caller's dict is mutated
